title: Experts disagree on new paqad-ai report command group
context:
Chief architect: Not a real disagreement: the two claims say the same thing. The issue names the command 'paqad-ai report speed [--change <id>] [--json] [--since <date>]', so it is a new top-level report group that leaves feature, metrics, compliance and discovery report untouched; the seats' owner question on where it lives is settled by that text. Pick this option to accept both.

Target: new paqad-ai report command group
- solution-architect: there is no top-level report verb today; existing report verbs are subcommands (feature report, metrics report, compliance report), so report speed adds a new top-level group and must not shadow or rename those
- application-architect: no top-level `report` command exists today (report lives as a subcommand of feature, discovery, compliance and metrics in src/cli/commands), so `paqad-ai report speed` needs a new top-level group registered in the CLI entry, kept thin: parse flags, call src/speed-report/report.ts, print
